cases.prompt: 制作 Vue 页面，显示全部和已读两个按钮，点击后更新页面的当前筛选文字。不需要外部图片。

files.content:
<script setup>
defineProps({ filters: { type: Array, required: true }, active: { type: String, required: true } })
const emit = defineEmits(['change'])
</script>
<template><nav><button v-for="filter in filters" :key="filter" :aria-pressed="active === filter" @click="emit('change', filter)">{{ filter }}</button></nav></template>
